name: Energizing Vial (Major)
text:
This sealed glass vial has no stopper and is filled with pure white light. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is +28 and spell DC is 38.
- Armor After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, you can Step as a free action once per round until the end of your next turn.

- Weapon After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, your Strikes with the weapon deal 1d8 persistent,electricity damage until the end of your next turn.

Effect: Energizing Vial - Weapon
